The method `nextElement` is called on an `Enumeration` object `loggers` which is obtained from `LogManager.getCurrentLoggers()`. The `nextElement` method, as per the API documentation, throws a `NoSuchElementException` if there are no more elements in the enumeration. The code snippet checks if there are more elements in the enumeration using `hasMoreElements()` before calling `nextElement()`. This check ensures that `nextElement` is only called when there are indeed more elements, thus avoiding the `NoSuchElementException`.
answer: The `NoSuchElementException` is avoided by the check `if (loggers.hasMoreElements())` before calling `nextElement()`.
